duas.title: Bismillah - Upon beginning to eat
duas.transliteration: Bismillāh. And if you forget then when you remember, say: Bismillāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih.
duas.english_translation: When anyone of you begins eating, say: With the Name of Allah. And if you forget then, when you remember, say: With the Name of Allah, in the beginning, and in the end.
duas.arabic_text: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ

duas.title: Dua for food and milk
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi, wa aṭ'imnā khayran minh. Whomever Allah has given milk to drink, should say: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi, wa zidnā minh.
duas.english_translation: Whomever Allah has given food, should say: O Allah, bless us in it and provide us with better than it. Whomever Allah has given milk to drink, should say: O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it.
duas.arabic_text:
مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: "اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ"،

وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ "اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ"
